Method of Attack: Phishing emails delivering spam using fake government economic stimulus checks as bait to steal personal information
Phishing scams impersonating IRS to steal taxpayers' personal information
Phishing attacks exploiting COVID-19 pandemic to infect victims with malware and harvest personal info
Selling fake COVID-19 cures, vaccines, testing kits, counterfeit sanitizing products and PPE
Malware inserted in mobile apps designed to track COVID-19 spread to steal information
Malicious COVID-19 websites and apps that lock access to devices until ransom payment
Solicitations for donations to fake charities or crowdfunding sites
Impacted Systems: Personal computers and devices of potential victims targeted by phishing and malware
Attack Vector: Spam impersonating government agencies (IRS, CDC, WHO)
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing emails asking to verify personal information for economic stimulus checks
Fake COVID-19 cure and PPE product offers
Malicious COVID-19 themed websites and apps
